description: This file defines macros and function prototypes for managing commit slabs, which are data structures used to allocate and handle memory chunks in an efficient manner. It provides macros to declare slabs, initialize them, and declare function prototypes for slab operations such as initialization, clearing, and accessing elements.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a commit slab with a specified stride.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a commit slab with default parameters.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears the commit slab, freeing resources.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Deeply clears the slab, calling a provided free function on each element.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an element at a specific position, with optional addition if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Returns a pointer to an element at a specific position.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next available slot in the slab.
